title: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy explicitly allows every origin
description: The response sets Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy to cross-origin, which is the permissive value: any site may embed the resource and read it through a no-cors or cross-origin load. The header is present, so DPK-DAST-014 (missing CORP) stays silent; the finding is the deliberate opt-out of the protection that rule asks for.
remediation: Set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy to same-origin for application responses, or same-site where subdomains legitimately share assets. Keep cross-origin only for resources that are public by design.
limitation: One header value. It does not classify the resource (public image versus authenticated document), so a deliberate public asset and an accidental application response look identical.
